title: BDR Pattern Explained
body:
When you treat your data as the source of truth about constraints (rather than choosing arbitrary limits up front), surprising things happen. Some fields that you assumed were 'short strings' turn out to commonly reach 200+ characters. Others you thought would be large are almost always under 50 characters.

This is the semantic-ex method applied to practice.
